scope: The surviving hilltop Asirgarh Fort above Burhanpur, with the upper stone rampart, interpreted west terraces of Kamargarh and Malaygarh, gate masonry, twin-minaret mosque and mapped reservoirs.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla map native original, matched against Wellcome’s independently scanned 1880 Gazetteer leaf. Shows the narrow lower spur, stone-lined saddle, upper circuit, ponds and Jami mosque site.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the published Qualla media. The Asirgad map is the exact copy transferred to Commons, and its imprint and cartography match the 1880 government volume independently. The dated Abbott drawing depicts the grave enclosure and other gallery files have attribution conditions.
